svg.title: Reference-frequency phase and delay are distinct calibration quantities
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Reference-frequency phase and delay are distinct calibration quantities
Noiseless synthetic line: b₀ = 0.3 rad at 1000 MHz; delay = 2 ns
line prediction; blue dots train the fit
Open square: held-out 1000.5 MHz; it checks prediction, not independent acquisition.
Mean frequency 1000.166667 MHz: bmean = 0.297905605 rad ≠ b₀ at 1000 MHz.
Scalar phase correction at the carrier leaves the 2 ns slope
Correct carrier subtraction: +0.0125664 rad at 999 MHz; −0.0188496 rad at 1001.5 MHz.
The fit estimates combined receiver + fixture delay unless fixture slope is separately known.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
